title: Train the expert's recovery basin on learner-prefix states
hypothesis: PPO fine-tuning from faithfully reconstructed learner-prefix states expands the expert's grasp-recovery basin because training encounters the states where ordinary expert takeover drops the pen.

prediction.rationale: Baseline is equal-budget PPO fine-tuning from expert-prefix states; a 20-point takeover advantage would justify reconsidering expert-generated repair evidence after D-045's failed recovery contrast.

protocol.command: gpu run "bash -lc 'source ~/IsaacLab/source_env.sh && python scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py --config config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml --study learner_prefix_recovery_ppo --output-dir logs/pen_spin_learner_prefix_recovery_ppo'"
code_changes: Extend the existing stage script and config to fine-tune the qualified checkpoint using rsl_rl and ShadowHandSpinPPORunnerCfg; do not start another expert-discovery effort.
Build a 128-case fresh training-prefix bank. Reconstruct states through the qualified closed-loop prefix method, not action-tape replay or an unqualified simulator snapshot.

Use three paired training replicates. Curriculum arm: 75% learner prefixes and 25% expert prefixes; control: 100% expert prefixes. Both execute 120 frozen prefix steps followed by 240 PPO-controlled steps.
Give each arm exactly 16384 training episodes per replicate, identical optimizer settings and equal trainable transition budgets; exclude prefix transitions from PPO updates.
Freeze the learner parent, checkpoint, training curriculum and last-checkpoint selection before evaluation; do not select checkpoints using the evaluation manifests.
Evaluate both fine-tuned policies and the original qualified expert after learner prefixes on 64 fresh cases per replicate, scoring the existing episode-level sustained-success rule.
Budget 98304 training episodes, 128 training-bank episodes, 576 evaluation episodes and 24 additional prefix-reproducibility episodes.
Use paired hierarchical intervals that retain training-replicate variation, and report takeover drops separately without treating spin-rate gains as success gains.
Freeze and ledger-check all manifest RNG streams before running. Do not replace the expert or collect repair labels in this study.
Unlike deferred R-052, this changes the expert's training-state distribution rather than filtering its existing corrections; D-045 establishes why the unchanged expert is insufficient.

falsified_by: An upper paired interval bound below +0.20 refutes the predicted advantage; an interval including zero is not evidence of improvement. Failed closed-loop prefix reproducibility makes the experiment uninterpretable and stops training.
direction: Continue researching the single-step exploration pipeline with plateau-triggered trace repair, extended to pen spinning on the Shadow Hand (Isaac Lab Isaac-ShadowHandSpin-Stage{1,2,3}-Direct-v0, vendored in lares/envs/isaac_pen_spin; 157-d full obs, 20-d action, 60 Hz, 360-step episodes). Expert demonstrations: first try a hand-written scripted spinning controller; also search online for an existing trained pen-spinning policy; if neither qualifies, train an RL expert (rsl_rl PPO on the box). No budget ceiling on GPU hours or LLM calls. Known gaps to turn into questions: the env's spin_rate is roll about the pen's own long axis (not end-over-end twirl), success is per step with no episode rule, and the pipeline (manifests, obs schema, runner, records) is MetaWorld-only today. Debug issues, improve the pipeline, and turn unexpected findings into concrete research questions; document results and limitations.

advisor.reasoning: Changing the expert's training-state distribution is a legitimate recovery-basin experiment, distinct from unchanged-expert takeover and filtering existing corrections. However, spending 99032 episodes and zero LLM calls should follow R-054's 2080-episode test of a route that avoids expert retraining; three training replicates also provide limited resolution of training variability. Reconsider after R-054 establishes whether expert recovery remains a repair-evidence bottleneck, retaining scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py and config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml. Falsified_by: the predicted paired_success_difference increase of at least 0.20 against equal-budget expert-prefix PPO fine-tuning is refuted by an upper paired interval bound below +0.20; failed prefix reproducibility instead makes the experiment uninterpretable.
